meta.description: Review or plan performance, memory, allocation, concurrency, caching, latency, throughput, profiling, benchmark, capacity, and language-runtime work. Use when a task mentions speed, memory, scale, load, p95/p99 latency, CPU, heap, allocations, async/concurrency, streaming, database query cost, caching, or artifacts `30-language-profiles.md` and performance-related quality scenarios.

copy.tagline: 审查性能瓶颈并规划优化方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要分析应用性能、内存与延迟问题并制定优化计划
copy.tagline_en: Review performance bottlenecks and plan optimization
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze performance, memory, and latency issues to plan optimizations

howto.what: 它会让 Claude 在性能相关任务中先找证据定指标，再提出最小改动；产出假设、基线/目标、剖析/基准计划、优化建议、验证证据，并记录权衡。
howto.when: 当任务提到速度、内存、规模等性能关键词，或涉及延迟、CPU、缓存等性能相关话题时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这段代码的内存分配和并发瓶颈
say.note: Claude 会先定指标并收集证据再分析。

say.text: 我的接口 p95 延迟高，做个优化计划并说明回滚风险
say.note: Claude 会形成假设、基线并给出最小改动建议。

say.text: 对这套 API 设计一个缓存方案，并考虑失效问题
say.note: Claude 会把缓存当作正确性而非加速来对待。

howto.what_en: Claude gathers evidence, chooses a metric, suggests the minimal fix, and records hypothesis, baseline, plan, recommendation, validation, and tradeoffs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task mentions speed, memory, scale, latency, CPU, caching, or other performance-related topics.

say_en.text: Analyze this code's memory allocations and concurrency bottlenecks.
say_en.note: Claude will first set metrics and gather evidence.

say_en.text: My endpoint's p95 latency is high; make a plan with rollback risk.
say_en.note: Claude will form a hypothesis, baseline, and minimal fix.

say_en.text: Design a caching scheme for this API, considering invalidation.
say_en.note: Claude treats caching as correctness, not a speed button.
